rebuttal_or_critique: I acknowledge the concerns raised by Dr. Varma regarding the transient nature of food price shocks, but with headline CPI at 7.44% and food inflation at 11.51%, we cannot ignore the risk of these shocks spilling over into broader inflation expectations. While I agree with Dr. Goyal that core inflation at 4.90% shows resilience, the breach of the upper tolerance band is significant. Maintaining the status quo on the repo rate is appropriate to evaluate the persistence of these food-led pressures, while the 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance remains necessary to address the excess liquidity of 120,000 crore and ensure that monetary conditions remain aligned with our target of 4.00%.
